elements.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
elements.evidence: Section 6.1 expressly states that the Company has “no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation under this Agreement” and may participate in similar projects.

elements.element: Exclusivity is limited to a defined product category.
elements.evidence: The clause eliminates exclusivity rather than establishing an exclusivity obligation limited to a defined product category.

elements.element: Exclusivity lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no 12-month exclusivity period; it instead provides for non-exclusivity.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet service levels.
elements.evidence: No automatic termination trigger tied to HDI’s failure to meet service levels is stated; exclusivity is eliminated outright.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet delivery dates.
elements.evidence: No automatic termination trigger tied to HDI’s failure to meet delivery dates is stated; exclusivity is eliminated outright.
